target_customer: Division 8 (doors, frames, hardware) distributors and estimators in construction
problem: Division 8 takeoff is slow and error prone across thousands of spec pages; Bild reads plans and specs, builds opening schedules, prices bids and exports to ERPs.
business_model: B2B SaaS for estimating teams (pricing not found)

founders.name: Roop Pal
prior_employers: Google (youngest full-time engineer per YC page)
previous_startups: Listed as 2x founder on YC page

founders.name: Puneet Sukhija
education: University of British Columbia (CS, dropped out)
previous_startups: Home building business, acquired when he was 23 (per YC page)

competitors.name: Togal.AI
competitors.traction_then: User base grew from 250 in 2022 to 2,500+ in 2023 (per source)

competitors.name: Kreo
competitors.what: Low cost AI takeoff with a plain language assistant

competitors.name: STACK Assist
competitors.what: AI door, window and room detection inside STACK

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading blueprints and specs reliably, cross referencing hardware sets and matching ERP formats is hard computer vision plus document understanding, and typos cost bids.

defensibility.rationale: Narrowing to Division 8 with ERP exports (Comsense, Avaware, ProTech) creates integration depth, but general takeoff tools can expand into the wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copycat reaction found; takeoff players remained general purpose through the search.

market_need_then: YC page cites about $50B a year spent on manual blueprint processing (another profile says $30B); Division 8 estimators work from thousands of spec pages with tight timelines.

branding.domain_note: bild.ai; main site now redirects to d8.bild.ai for the Division 8 product

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, metrics driven; short benefit headlines

branding.community_and_virality: Won Product Hunt awards per a listing; little brand coverage

brand_strength.rationale: Short distinctive name but little brand coverage.

pivots.from: AI to read blueprints and estimate construction materials broadly (launch positioning)
pivots.to: AI takeoff focused on Division 8 doors, frames and hardware
pivots.why: not stated; narrowed to a specific trade by the current site

outcome_analysis: Bild AI raised a $3.1M seed led by Khosla in July 2025 and narrowed from general blueprint reading to Division 8 estimating, claiming clients bid 50 percent more with smaller teams. A co-founder's construction experience and the document AI tailwind support the story, but no later round or exit was found, so the outcome is open.
notes: Round amount is cited by the YC page (Business Insider, July 3, 2025) and PropTechBuzz; the Business Insider article itself redirected and was not opened, and PropTechBuzz was seen only as a search result, so co-investors are unverified. Togal figure is from 2023; some sources give founding as 2024 versus Feb 2025.
